$comment: EMERGENCY 2026-10-20 (operator OK; host at ~114 MB free, swap 4.6/6.1 GB, ~10 review-loop-cli + 13 review-job = ~12 GB). maxLiveReviewRounds caps how many review rounds (review-job / review-loop-cli processes) may run on the host at once; the review daemon dispatches no new review while that many are live, and owed reviews stay queued. REVERT CONDITION: remove this file (or raise the cap) once the memory-aware host admission (host.minMemoryHeadroomMb + host.maxReviewDispatchPerTick, branch lane/verify-admission-heartbeat-timeout-memory) is merged and loaded on the review daemon. Env override: WE_REVIEW_MAX_LIVE_ROUNDS. HOT-SWAP (2026-10-20): maxLiveReviewRounds (1..12), redTeamReservedSeats (0..8), capMemoryFloorMb, capFloorValue and capMemoryHysteresisMb can be changed with NO rebuild via the runtime-operator layer: `node scripts/operations/run.mjs runtime-setting set reviewConcurrency.<key> <n> --actor=<login> --reason=...` (applies next review tick; logged `(runtime)`; `unset` falls back to this file). Precedence env > runtime > this file. SAFETY RULE (operator ruling 2026-10-20, REPLACES the >36 load drop-back rule above — reviews barely use CPU): when free RAM + free swap < capMemoryFloorMb (standard 3072) the effective cap drops to capFloorValue (standard 5) until free memory is back to floor + capMemoryHysteresisMb (standard 1024); each switch is logged with its values.
